note: Illustrative teaching values, not vendor benchmarks.

components.label: Client
components.description: Users, browsers or devices that send requests to the system.

components.label: DNS
components.description: Translates names like example.com into IP addresses; answers are cached along the way.

components.label: CDN
components.description: Edge servers close to users that cache and serve static or cacheable content.

components.label: API gateway
components.description: Single entry point that routes requests and handles authentication and rate limits.

components.label: Load balancer
components.description: Spreads incoming requests across the healthy instances of a service.

components.label: App server
components.description: Stateless service that runs your business logic.

components.label: Serverless function
components.description: Code that runs on demand and scales per request; you pay per invocation.

components.label: Worker
components.description: Background process that takes jobs from a queue and processes them.

components.label: Scheduler
components.description: Starts jobs on a timetable, like cron.

components.label: SQL database (primary)
components.description: Relational database that accepts writes; the source of truth.

components.label: SQL read replica
components.description: Read-only copy that follows the primary and may lag slightly behind it.

components.label: NoSQL store
components.description: Partitioned key-value or document store that scales out horizontally.

components.label: Cache
components.description: In-memory key-value store that keeps hot data close to the application.

components.label: Object storage
components.description: Durable storage for files and large blobs, addressed by key.

components.label: Search index
components.description: Inverted index that answers full-text and filtered search queries.

components.label: Data warehouse
components.description: Columnar store built for large analytical queries over historical data.

components.label: Message queue
components.description: Buffers jobs so producers and consumers can work at different speeds.

components.label: Event stream
components.description: Durable, ordered, replayable log of events split into partitions.

components.label: Pub/sub topic
components.description: Delivers each published message to every subscriber.

components.label: Feature store
components.description: Serves the same feature values for training (offline) and inference (online).

components.label: Training pipeline
components.description: Turns data and code into a trained, versioned model.

components.label: Model registry
components.description: Stores model versions with their metadata, metrics and approval status.

components.label: Model server (CPU)
components.description: Serves predictions from smaller models on CPU machines.

components.label: Model server (GPU)
components.description: Serves predictions from larger models on GPUs, batching requests together.

components.label: Batch inference job
components.description: Scores large datasets offline, usually on a schedule.

components.label: Drift monitor
components.description: Watches input data and predictions for changes that degrade a model.

components.label: LLM endpoint (hosted API)
components.description: A model provider’s API: pay per token and run no GPUs yourself.

components.label: Self-hosted LLM (GPU)
components.description: An open-weight model on your own GPUs, batching many requests at once.

components.label: Embedding model
components.description: Turns text or images into vectors so similar items end up close together.

components.label: Vector database
components.description: Finds the stored vectors nearest to a query vector (approximate nearest neighbours).

components.label: Reranker
components.description: Re-scores the top candidates from retrieval with a stronger, slower model.

components.label: Prompt / semantic cache
components.description: Returns stored answers for repeated or very similar prompts.

components.label: Guardrail filter
components.description: Checks inputs and outputs against safety and policy rules.

components.label: Agent orchestrator
components.description: Runs the plan, act, observe loop: calls the model and tools step by step.

components.label: Tool / function
components.description: An external capability an agent can call, such as search or a database query.

components.label: Evaluation service
components.description: Scores model outputs against test sets and rubrics.
